about: The rules of spec/engine/network.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe command table .rdata 0x143C898 (574 entries); dispatcher 0x77BC10, switch 0x77BC8C, shared handler 0x77BEC3; queue 0x956E10 (UiManager+0x82CD0); consumer 0x951E00; HostGameMessage constructor 0x918D70

rules.title: The menu's host command becomes a host-game message

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe session onMessage 0x56A890 (jump table 0x56AA48; 0x13 -> 0x56A959); updateState 0x56A6D0 (state 5 -> 0x565450); server object vtable 0x01418140, create 0x54B0B0

rules.title: The session hosts the level in process

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe createClient 0x54AEE0, selection at 0x54AF2C (22 bytes, continuing at 0x54AF42); setTransportMode 0x650E60: 0 in-memory 0x4F1E00, 1 sockets 0x4F1E60, 2 remote 0x5F0F40; play test 2026-10-12

rules.title: A local multiplayer session needs the in-memory transport

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe game-server join 0xDBC440, drops at 0xDBA466 / 0xDBA4DE; imports of WS2_32, WinHTTP, ICMP, NETAPI32

rules.title: Offline matches open no sockets
One game process at a time

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe Client::sendJoin 0x55DFB0, clan tag check 0x743A70, default name at 0x841930 (string 0x1433338); server join 0x865D70, stats request 0x85AED0

rules.title: The join carries the local profile; offline the player is "Human player"

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe server list at UiManager+0xC8958 (record constructor 0x5ECF60), row writer 0x956A80, rows rebuilt by 0x958BF0; level catalogue UiManager+0xC3F34 built by 0x951480

rules.title: A browser row is a server record; its mode is a key

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe row writer 0x956A80; key -> name walk 0x9293C0 (thiscall(UiManager+0xC3F34), ret 8) called at 0x956C2F; level lookup 0x918990; blank Conquest rows, 2026-11-16

rules.title: A key shared by two modes blanks the rows of one of them

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe multiplayerMaps builder 0x9421F0 (tag compare at 0x942247 against record+0x30)

rules.title: Which levels a menu offers is the level's declaration

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe setTransportMode 0x650E60; factories 0x4F1E00 (vtable 0x1411934), 0x4F1E60 (vtable 0x1411960), 0x5F0F40 -> 0x5F0D50 (vtable 0x141BE04); shared base vtable 0x141128C; UDP create methods 0x4F5280 / 0x4F5380 / 0x4F54A0 -> 0x4F1EC0; in-memory create 0x4F5020 -> 0x4F1D60

rules.title: The transport is a socket factory installed for the whole process

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe UDP socket methods 0x4E3290 (socket 0x4E32E9, bind 0x4E3301), 0x4E3350 (socket 0x4E337F, bind 0x4E33B6), sendto 0x4E3025, recvfrom 0x4EF52F; Havok socket 0xC6A3C0 (string 0x1481F80); DirtySock thunks 0xC55604-0xC5568E called from 0xD7DB7A-0xD7F963; WS2_32 IAT 0x14059AC-0x1405A4C

rules.title: The game's own sockets are UDP only

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe connection state names 0xC02AF0-0xC02B5F (strings 0x147D360-0x147D4D4); "ConnectionManager" 0x147D888; managers Ghost / MoveClient / MoveServer / Voice 0x147DA6C-0x147DAA8; recorder states 0x147D2CC-0x147D310; packing types 0x140BB2C-0x140BBC8; frame / timeout setting names 0x1417DE0-0x1418394, 0x141D810-0x141D8D8

rules.title: The connection layer: a challenge handshake, ghosts, moves and voice

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe field names 0x142CC84-0x142CE80 (network / core), 0x142D100-0x142D714 (client / server), 0x142DC00-0x142DDB0 (game); setting strings 0x14183E4, 0x141D9FC, 0x1418624, 0x141D8F4, 0x141D9EC; readers 0x565654, 0x55D0EF, 0x561D9B, 0x8587CC, 0x6561A1

rules.title: The network settings the executable reads

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe option lookup 0x4F4CF0 over 0x155D008; call sites listen 0x86B19F, dedicated 0x55D52B, port 0x5FC429, pingInterval 0x5FC374, heartBeatInterval 0x570488, maxQueriesPerSecond 0x856992, queryPortOffset 0x8569B5, networkProtocolId 0x565A07, loginToken 0x5623C6 / 0x56B7E1 / 0x580010 / 0x5889D9 / 0x5B104A, requestState 0x5B4EF5, requestStateParams 0x5B4F36

rules.title: Start-up options are looked up by name

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe WinMain helper 0x401EE0 (called from 0xC51FBB): compares at 0x401F11 / 0x401F2E / 0x401F4D / 0x401F6A against strings 0x1409838, 0x140982C, 0x1409824; CreateMutexA 0x401FB7; error checks 0xB7 and 5 at 0x401FC7 / 0x401FD4

rules.title: Three switches in WinMain decide the instance mutex
Network.Version is the build's string unless an option overrides it

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe 0x54BBA0 (jump table 0x54BC70, 14 entries), strings 0x1417960-0x1417A4C, log 0x141793C; second user 0x558FA4; menu strings 0x141A2C4-0x141A32C, 0x1418CA0-0x1418CB8

rules.title: A refused or dropped client gets one of fourteen reasons
Both ends read the title id and the protocol version

evidence.ref: two callers of the checksum at 0x5681AB and 0x829D7D, a stored 16-byte digest, the setting name at 0x142CD70 and reason 12 at 0x14179D0; no compare site found

rules.title: The level checksum is computed on both load paths
PunkBuster loads only from its folder

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe 0x86B0D0 (category compare at 0x86B0D6, types 0x86B0EE); listen option 0x86B19F; parser 0x8585E0 (':' at 0x858607, '-' at 0x858690, atoi 0x85869D); host default at 0x86B1E7-0x86B1F8 (string 0x141240C); TitleId 0x86B267, ProtocolVersion 0x86B345

rules.title: The server listens where `-listen` says, else on Network.ServerPort

evidence.ref: 0x55D502-0x55D545 (strings 0x1416738 "win32", 0x1418490 "dedicated", 0x1416724 "linux"); no string "ServerOptions" / "RemoteAdminPort" in the executable; setting names 0x142D568-0x142D688

rules.title: The client executable has the server, not the dedicated server's front end

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe 0x55CE50 (event 10 -> 0x55D040); setting 0x14183F8 read at 0x55D07F, ':' search 0x55D0C6, ServerPort 0x55D0EF, format ":%d" 0x14183E0; message 0x551480 (type 0x14 at 0x551483, vtable 0x1417D20); post 0x55D17F; other constructors' callers 0x5B3FF5, 0x5B43C4, 0x952413, 0x95E5C2, 0x95F267

rules.title: A client can join a server by address

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe client strings 0x141C2BC-0x141C2FC; host parts 0x149D080 / 0x149D088 used at 0xDDC39C / 0xDDC31E; 0x149C7D0 at 0xDD6EC9; theaterIp / theaterPort 0x149B5E0 / 0x149B5FC; overrides 0x149A235-0x149A2E5; states 0x1505214-0x1505394; requestState 0x5B4EF5

rules.title: The back-end is Plasma: FESL first, Theater from FESL

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe 0xDBAB60 (socket 0xDBABED, bind 0xDBAC6F, broadcast address 0xDBACA9-0xDBACED); init 0xDBAD00 (object 0x4954 bytes, constructor 0xDB7110) called at 0xE0110E; caller 0xE01070 in vtable 0x14A022C; strings 0x1498578, 0x1498C74, 0x1498C9C, 0x1498DC4, 0x149A8E5; session types 0x146E970-0x146E9F4
